The '''posenaur''' was a creeping [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] native to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. Moving about on two legs, posenaurs had webbed feet and long tails to help them cross water and run on dry land respectively. Hunting rodents in packs, posenaurs had razor-sharp claws and powerful jaws.
